scope: Strengthen the connected first-run final-search acceptance: run the real Greenhouse adapter, normalization and persistence path against deterministic synthetic HTTP responses; prove the durable search history records a nonzero result and the user can see that job in Jobs after reload.

environment.source_transport: httpx.MockTransport with two synthetic Greenhouse API responses; no network access
environment.delivery: local-only; no push or hosted automation

acceptance: The connected first-run wizard passes its selected profile, enabled source and saved-search ID through the durable DISCOVER operation.
The production Greenhouse adapter requests board metadata and a job inventory through an injected MockTransport, normalizes one synthetic Python Engineer posting and persists it.
Durable profile search history records COMPLETED with results=1 and the selected saved-search filter.
After browser reload/navigation, the Python Engineer posting is visible in the Jobs view.
Browser egress is blocked; the source adapter has no live transport; no application submission or collection scheduling outside the selected operation occurs.

checks.evidence: 1 connected Chromium first-run workflow passed in 10.11s, including fact review, manual-only gate, actual adapter/normalizer persistence, durable history, and visible positive job result.
33 integration and source-adapter tests passed in 16.43s.

checks.command: .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m py_compile tests/browser/test_first_run_wizard.py; git diff --check; python -m tools.coordination.lane_coordination validate
checks.evidence: Test compilation, whitespace and lane ownership validation passed.

not_run: A browser-created profile and actual resume file upload/extraction during this wizard run; the test begins with an isolated profile and a synthetic pending resume-derived fact.
Live job-provider requests, PostgreSQL, full Python repository suite, hosted checks/review.
Cross-device persistence of browser-local setup acknowledgments.
limitations: This improves the final search step but does not prove every first-run setup step through fresh profile creation, resume upload/extraction, and preference entry. MJ-REQ-250 remains PARTIAL.
Synthetic Greenhouse responses exercise the real adapter code but do not establish live provider availability or production credentials/terms.
GitHub issue #251 remains open pending local-only source synchronization; no push.

safety.external_requests: NONE; source adapter used MockTransport and browser routes blocked egress.
safety.collection: Only the explicitly selected local DISCOVER operation ran.
